text: This report reviews and recommends amending the Zoning By-law to permit an apartment building at 467 and 469 Spadina Road, within the existing building envelope, with the exception of permitting additional height to reflect a previous Committee of Adjustment approval.

City Council on November 8 and 9, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Zoning By-law 569-2013 for the lands at 467 and 469 Spadina Road substantially in accordance with the draft Zoning By-law Amendment included as Attachment 4 to the report (September 29, 2023) from the Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York District. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to make stylistic and technical changes to the draft Zoning By-law Amendment as may be required.
